name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role or class colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: Party mode now shows each player's buffs and debuffs as icons on their row — buffs framed green, debuffs red — each with a live countdown. Imagine-lockout and imagine-cast effects show the Battle-Imagine card.
Click any buff/debuff tile to open a tooltip listing all of that player's effects, each as a live cooldown tile with its description.
A Configure panel to pick exactly which buffs and debuffs to show — separate Buffs and Debuffs tabs, search, show-all-except / show-only modes, and same-named effects grouped together.
Player-tile size and how many effects to show per row (up to 12) are configurable per mode; buffs & debuffs can also show in the DPS list view.
CombatMeter now has its own tiles in the Stellar plugins window — Settings and Combat History.
changed: Uploads are far smaller and faster — combat data is now compressed, so a long raid finishes uploading in seconds instead of minutes.
fixed: While a Battle Imagine transforms you (Lucy, Natsu…), the meter keeps showing your real class — name, icon and role colour no longer switch to the transform. History rows, the snapshot and the Discord card show your real class too, and a run that ends while you're transformed now saves your real character's stats and gear.

When a Battle Imagine transforms you (Lucy, Natsu…), your runs are now logged under your real class instead of the transform — including when the fight ends while you're still transformed — and your gear and loadout are kept for that run.
Uploads are more reliable — a dropped connection or a slow write no longer loses part of a run.
